Soul Feasting
+1 stealth hunt action.
nec: Gain 1 blood, or you may burn a wraith to move 4 blood from the
blood bank to this vampire (this is a (D) action if you do not control
the wraith).
NEC: As above, but gain an additional blood

If I target a wraith controlled by another Methuselah with Soul
Feasting is the action still at +1 stealth?.

Regards
